recent_posts.title: Codemotion Madrid 2026 recap
recent_posts.summary: Cassidy Williams recaps her keynote talk at Codemotion Madrid 2026, titled 'Our Brains in the AI Era'. The talk covered balanced perspectives on AI in the workplace, including forward-thinking hiring practices, the importance of guardrails when using AI, learning in public, and the continued need for human mentorship alongside AI tools. She reflects on speaking at three events this month about AI, advocating for a nuanced middle ground between being fully AI-enthusiastic and anti-AI.

recent_posts.title: Shipping todometer, version 3!
recent_posts.summary: Cassidy Williams has released todometer v3, a major update to her open source Electron/React desktop to-do app with a progress bar. Key changes include: task editing and drag-and-drop reordering using dnd kit, migration from localStorage to SQLite for data storage (enabling cloud sync via file placement), a new settings menu, a local API and MCP server for integration with other tools, updated SVG icons and logo, and an automated GitHub Actions build/release pipeline with auto-update support. AI tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude) were used to assist with state management and the SQLite migration.

recent_posts.title: Connecting the Logitech MX Creative Console to Elgato Lights
recent_posts.summary: A developer shares how they connected a Logitech MX Creative Console to Elgato Key Lights using GitHub Copilot CLI to generate Python scripts. Since the two competing brands don't natively integrate, they used Copilot's Plan Mode to write scripts that communicate with the Elgato lights' REST API, enabling button-triggered light control from the console. The resulting scripts are available in a public GitHub repository.

recent_posts.title: Deep Dish Swift 2026 recap
recent_posts.summary: Cassidy Williams recaps her opening keynote at Deep Dish Swift 2026 in Chicago, a ~300-person iOS-focused conference. Her talk used an elaborate pizza metaphor as a visual wrapper around a presentation about AI, the state of the industry, and the importance of knowledge sharing. She describes the creative challenge of making slides look like a genuine pizza talk while delivering substantive technical content, and notes the unusually strong audience response to her talk-writing approach.

recent_posts.title: A history of styling choices leading to native CSS
recent_posts.summary: A personal account of how the todometer app's styling stack evolved over nearly a decade, moving from Less to node-sass/CSS Modules to PostCSS with postcss-nested, and finally to pure native CSS. The migration was made possible by CSS nesting and CSS custom properties becoming browser standards, eliminating the need for preprocessors entirely. The post highlights the difference between postcss-nested (Sass-like syntax) and postcss-nesting (CSS spec syntax), and shows how an iterative migration strategy made the final cleanup trivial.

recent_posts.title: Notes for my future self on how to set up a camera for streaming
recent_posts.summary: A personal reference guide for setting up a Sony a6400 camera for live streaming. Covers key menu settings including Video Mode, Continuous AF, Manual Exposure, XAVC S 4K recording at 30p 60M, HDMI output at 1080p, and Auto Power OFF temperature. Also explains how to use Sony's Clear Image Zoom feature to crop a wide 16mm lens view, and tips for adjusting White Balance and Creative Style for consistent colors.

recent_posts.title: Creating CSS art with gradients, corner-shape, and skew transforms
recent_posts.summary: A hands-on exploration of combining CSS wavy gradients, skew transforms, and the corner-shape property to create a small piece of CSS art resembling a diving board. The author shares the process from sketch to CodePen, including a recorded walkthrough, noting the challenges of skew transforms and the intentional choice to code without AI assistance.

recent_posts.title: How passkeys work
recent_posts.summary: A beginner-friendly explainer on how passkeys work using public/private key cryptography, where a private key stays on your device and a public key is shared with the website. Covers the core handshake mechanism, compares passkeys to passwords and password managers, and offers a measured take on their real-world trade-offs — including device dependency and phishing resistance — without overselling them as a universal solution.

recent_posts.title: Cassidy Williams returns to weekly Twitch streaming and YouTube videos
recent_posts.summary: Cassidy Williams announces she is returning to regular video content creation after a hiatus following maternity leave. She is streaming weekly on Twitch every Thursday and relaunching her YouTube channel, focusing on longer-form videos beyond the short-form content she previously made on TikTok.

recent_posts.title: Improving my newsletter's open rate the hard(er) way
recent_posts.summary: A newsletter author improved their open rate from 40-45% to mid-50s by asking subscribers to reply to emails, which helped improve email reputation with spam filters. The approach generated hundreds (possibly over a thousand) responses, which were manually answered without automation. This demonstrates how manual, non-scalable engagement tactics can effectively improve email deliverability metrics.
